lore.mc_calamity.desert_scourge1: Once, it was a majestic sea serpent that threatened none but the microscopic creatures it consumed.
lore.mc_calamity.desert_scourge2: After Ilmeris was incinerated, it became familiar with the hunt.
lore.mc_calamity.desert_scourge3: To survive, it quickly learned to seek greater prey.
lore.mc_calamity.desert_scourge4: Unfortunately for the scourge, it seems that it too was prey in the end.
lore.mc_calamity.desert_scourge5: After all, there is always a bigger fish in the sea.
lore.mc_calamity.eye_of_cthulhu1: In ages past, heroes made names for themselves facing such monsters.
lore.mc_calamity.eye_of_cthulhu2: Now they run rampant, spawning from vile influences left unchecked.
lore.mc_calamity.eye_of_cthulhu3: They blend well with the horrific injustice of their forebears.
lore.mc_calamity.eye_of_cthulhu4: Slaying one merely paves the way for a dozen more.
lore.mc_calamity.eye_of_cthulhu5: Surely this does not concern you, either.
lore.mc_calamity.king_slime1: Given time, these gelatinous creatures absorb each other and slowly grow in both size and strength.
lore.mc_calamity.king_slime2: There is little need to worry about this.
lore.mc_calamity.king_slime3: Naturally, slimes are nearly mindless and amass only by chance.
lore.mc_calamity.king_slime4: Though it appears they are capable of absorbing knowledge, if only in rudimentary form.
